title: The Jammed Printer
transcript:
Woman: Is the printer on the third floor still jammed? I need to print handouts for the two o'clock meeting.
Man: Yeah, it's been flashing the same error all morning. I called IT, but they can't come until tomorrow.
Woman: Tomorrow? That's cutting it close. The meeting's in an hour.
Man: Have you tried the one in the mail room? It's slow, but it works.
Woman: I didn't even know there was one down there.
Man: Most people don't. Just don't print in color, or it'll take forever.
Woman: Black and white's fine. I'll head down now.

options: She missed an important meeting this morning.
She cannot find the IT department's phone number.
She needs handouts printed before a meeting starts.
She accidentally printed her handouts in color.
